_readme: Maps filesystem paths to logical projects. Longest prefix wins. Applies to the session's working directory AND to every file an episode edits, so work done outside the folder you launched in still lands on the right project. Copy to aliases.json, edit, then run: ./chronicle-cli index --rebuild
_containers_readme: Optional. Overrides the built-in guess of which folder names are containers (a repo sits one level below one of these, not a project itself) rather than a project's own directory. Only used as a last-resort fallback when a file's project can't be resolved from a known session cwd or from 'projects' above. Replaces the built-in default entirely when set.
